key_findings.finding: The ORD target-product search returned exact product matches for coupling p-toluidine with 1-bromo-4-(trifluoromethyl)benzene. Reported yields for bromide-substrate matches were 54.2%, 53.9%, 53.8%, 53.6%, and 53.5%, all below the >70% threshold. The 53.6% record used the ester heteroaryl additive CCOC(=O)c1cc(C)no1, although it used t-BuXPhos and MTBD rather than the user-described catalyst/base combination.

source_tools.relevance: Exact target and aryl bromide substrate matches; record 8 contains the ester heteroaryl additive and gives 53.6%.

key_findings.finding: Closest additional record combining the exact target, AdBrettPhos catalyst, and the specified ester heteroaryl additive gave 52.7%, but used the aryl iodide analogue and MTBD. Other close exact-product records using AdBrettPhos with the bromide substrate range from 53.5% to 53.9%. The matching evidence therefore supports the <=70% category (No), not a >70% yield prediction; no exact record for the full specified reagent/base combination was returned.
